message.content:
I replaced the default-construct-then-copy-assign body with a member initializer list, so `values` and `stringIndexes` are copy-constructed directly in place (one allocation each) instead of being default-constructed and then reassigned.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values)
    , stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
